Weld Engineers are responsible for coordinating the management and support of all plant weld systems and documentation, and for working alongside Engineering on new weld machine controls and standards. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, ability, and essential duties required to successfully perform this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
cond_0045.responsibilities:
Adhere to and comply with all applicable federal, state, and OSHA environmental, health and safety laws, regulations, external & internal standards, and other requirements in all its operations which relate to its health, safety, and environmental aspects.
Work with Engineering and Quality teams using practices and procedures including APQP, PPAP, blueprint reading, GD&T, use of measuring instruments, checking aids / fixtures, computer applications, mechanical testing, and customer and IATF 16949 requirements.
Bring good organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills to support the team.
Help ensure Team Members use or wear the protective equipment required by [Company name masked].
Keep team members informed of any potential hazards and/or provide written instructions as to the measures to protect the Team Member.
Take every precaution reasonable in the circumstances for the protection of a Team Member and report any known contravention out of their control to their BU Leader/Manager.
Coordinate accident / incident investigations and work with the team to implement corrective actions and Continued Improvements.
Conduct monthly safety inspections and work with others to implement corrective actions.
Correct unsafe acts or conditions.
Correct or commend health & safety performance.
Share technical welding expertise with the weld lab, including personnel, equipment, documents, and records of compliance. Evaluate and make recommendations together with the team regarding current and new weld assembly processing, tooling, and equipment.
Support Engineering and Quality Assurance personnel as assigned with welding expertise to assist existing and new customer programs.
Coordinate the development and implementation of training and certification programs for production associates in robotic and hand GMAW/TIG welding techniques and procedures.
Work with the team to develop and implement work instructions for part fit-up, tack, weld, and repair requirements.
Collaborate on developing and implementing parameters for weld length, leg length, throat length, penetration, and structural quality for welded automotive assemblies.
Help develop and implement a training program for maintenance technicians in the troubleshooting and repair of robotic GMAW welding equipment.
Coordinate the development and implementation of a training program for troubleshooting and problem solving of welding issues.
Participate in APQP processes relating to the design of weld assembly work cells and tooling.
Recommend design changes to improve quality, reliability, and productivity of welding processes.
Work with the team to develop and implement documents and procedures for validation of welding equipment and processes to meet or exceed customer specifications.
Coordinate the setup and programming of robots for welding.
Support continual improvement in weld quality and weld processes.
Maintain weld drawings.
Work alongside Q.A., Engineering and Production departments' associates toward continual improvement of department methods, procedures, and policies; assist in the implementation of.
Communicate effectively with company personnel, customers, and vendors.
Attend and participate in department meetings, plant meetings, and training; participate in customer visitations as designated by the department manager.
Support new program launches and customer expectations.
Provide reports as required by the Engineering Manager or other departments.
Participate in Continual Improvement activities.
Adhere to customer requirements, Business Operating System, and company policies.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Able to use computer and software as required.
Able to travel.
Able to demonstrate understanding of how job performance affects product quality and customer satisfaction.
Able to work well with others; build and maintain positive employee relations.
Able to prepare, read, write, and interpret written reports, procedures, instructions, and guidelines.
Able to effectively present information and respond to questions from management, employees, suppliers and customers and work effectively within a team environment.
Able to organize, schedule, and manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
The work environment is a combination of office and manufacturing plant, with an emphasis on manufacturing plant. The individual must be able to perform all essential functions as appropriate on the plant floor, in meetings, and with employees, management, customers and suppliers.
Requires travel to customer and tooling facilities as needed.
Some of the equipment and tools used are computer, telephone, fax machine, copier/printer, and a projector.
cond_0045.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4 Year Weld Engineering Degree or equivalent
Minimum 3 - 5 years' experience in an automotive welding engineering, design, and program development environment
Strong experience / knowledge in robotic programming for welding processes, preferably using Fanuc or MotoMan equipment
Resistance Welding Experience
Knowledge in OSHA safety requirements
Strong Computer Skills
Able to travel
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency with Advanced Product Quality Planning methods
Prior experience in weld laboratory duties
Familiarity with APQP, PPAP, blueprint reading, GD&T, use of measuring instruments, checking aids / fixtures, and IATF 16949 requirements

Adhere to and exceed where possible all applicable federal, state, and OSHA environmental, health and safety laws, regulations, external & internal standards, and other requirements in all operations relating to health, safety, and environmental aspects.
Apply knowledge of Engineering and Quality practices and procedures including APQP, PPAP, blueprint reading, GD&T, use of measuring instruments, checking aids / fixtures, computer applications, mechanical testing, and customer and IATF 16949 requirements.

Strong computer skills are required.

Promote continual improvement in weld quality and weld processes.
Maintain weld drawings.
Achieve department objectives in support of company production, quality, and safety goals.

Adhere to and comply with, and exceed where possible, all applicable federal, state, and OSHA environmental, health and safety laws, regulations, external & internal standards, and other requirements in all operations relating to health, safety, and environmental aspects.
Stay familiar with Engineering and Quality practices and procedures including APQP, PPAP, blueprint reading, GD&T, use of measuring instruments, checking aids / fixtures, computer applications, mechanical testing, and customer and IATF 16949 requirements.
Maintain good organizational, leadership, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
Ensure Team Members use or wear the protective equipment required by [Company name masked].
Keep team members informed of any potential hazards and/or provide written instructions on measures to protect them.

Conduct accident / incident investigations and implement corrective actions and Continued Improvements.
Conduct monthly safety inspections and implement corrective actions.
Correct unsafe acts or conditions.
Correct or commend health & safety performance.
Provide technical welding expertise to the weld lab, regularly connecting with personnel on equipment, documents, and records of compliance. Evaluate and make recommendations regarding current and new weld assembly processing, tooling, and equipment.
Work closely with Engineering and Quality Assurance personnel to provide welding expertise supporting existing and new customer programs.
Develop and implement training and certification programs for production associates in robotic and hand GMAW/TIG welding techniques and procedures.
Develop and implement work instructions for part fit-up, tack, weld, and repair requirements.
Develop and implement parameters for weld length, leg length, throat length, penetration, and structural quality for welded automotive assemblies.
Develop and implement a training program for maintenance technicians in the troubleshooting and repair of robotic GMAW welding equipment.
Develop and implement a training program for troubleshooting and problem solving of welding issues.
Actively participate in APQP processes relating to the design of weld assembly work cells and tooling.
Recommend design changes to improve quality, reliability, and productivity of welding processes.
Develop and implement documents and procedures for validation of welding equipment and processes to meet or exceed customer specifications.
Supervise and manage the setup and programming of robots for welding.
Promote continual improvement in weld quality and weld processes.
Maintain weld drawings.
Achieve department objectives in support of company production, quality, and safety goals.
Work directly with Q.A., Engineering and Production department associates for continual improvement of department methods, procedures, and policies; assist in implementation.
Communicate regularly with company personnel, customers, and vendors.
Attend and actively contribute to department meetings, plant meetings, and training; participate in customer visitations as designated by the department manager.
Support new program launches and customer expectations.
Provide reports as required by the Engineering Manager or other departments.
Participate in Continual Improvement activities.
Adhere to customer requirements, Business Operating System, and company policies.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Use computer and software as required.
Able to travel.
Demonstrate understanding of how job performance affects product quality and customer satisfaction.
Work well with others; build and maintain positive employee relations.
Prepare, read, write, and interpret written reports, procedures, instructions, and guidelines.
Present information clearly and respond to questions from management, employees, suppliers, and customers; work effectively within a team environment.
Organize, schedule, and manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
The work environment is a combination of office and manufacturing plant, with an emphasis on manufacturing plant. The individual must be able to perform all essential functions on the plant floor, in meetings, and with employees, management, customers, and suppliers.
Requires travel to customer and tooling facilities as needed.
Some of the equipment and tools used include computer, telephone, fax machine, copier/printer, and a projector.

4-Year Weld Engineering Degree or equivalent
Minimum 3–5 years' experience in an automotive welding engineering, design, and program development environment

RESPONSIBILITY AND AUTHORITY:
Adhere to and comply with and exceed where possible all applicable federal, state, and OSHA environmental, health and safety laws, regulations, external & internal standards, and other requirements in all its operations which relate to its health, safety, and environmental aspects.
Familiarity with Engineering and Quality practices and procedures including APQP, PPAP, blueprint reading, GD&T, use of measuring instruments, checking aids / fixtures, computer applications, mechanical testing, and customer and IATF 16949 requirements.
Good organizational, leadership, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills
Ensure Team Members use or wear the protective equipment required by [Company name masked].
Members of any potential hazards and/or provide written instructions as to the measures to protect the Team Member
Take every precaution reasonable in the circumstances for the protection of a Team Member and report any known contravention out of their control to their BU Leader/Manager
Conduct accident / incident investigations and implement corrective actions and Continued Improvements
Conduct monthly safety inspections and implement corrective actions.
Correct unsafe acts or conditions.
Correct or commends health & safety performance.
cond_0311.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4 Year Weld Engineering Degree or equivalent
Minimum 3 - 5 years' experience in an automotive welding engineering, design, and program development environment
Strong experience / knowledge in robotic programming for welding processes, preferably using Fanuc or MotoMan equipment
Resistance Welding Experience
Knowledge in OSHA safety requirements
Strong Computer Skills
Able to travel
Able to use computer and software as required
Able to demonstrate understanding of how job performance affects product quality and customer satisfaction
Able to work well with others; build and maintain positive employee relations
Able to prepare, read, write, and interpret written reports, procedures, instructions, and guidelines
Able to effectively present information and respond to questions from management, employees, suppliers and customers and work effectively within a team environment
Able to organize, schedule, and manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
Preferred Requirements

Prior experience in weld laboratory duties
Provide technical welding expertise to the weld lab, including personnel, equipment, documents, and records of compliance. Evaluate and make recommendations regarding current and new weld assembly processing, tooling, and equipment
Provide Engineering and Quality Assurance personnel as assigned with welding expertise to support existing and new customer programs
Develop and implement training and certification program for production associates in robotic and hand GMAW/TIG welding techniques and procedures
Develop and implement work instructions for part fit-up, tack, weld, and repair requirements
Develop and implement parameters for weld length, leg length, throat length, penetration, and structural quality for welded automotive assemblies
Develop and implement a training program for maintenance technicians in the troubleshooting and repair of robotic GMAW welding equipment
Develop and implement a training program for troubleshooting and problem solving of welding issues
Participate in APQP processes relating to the design of weld assembly work cells and tooling
Recommend design changes to improve quality, reliability, and productivity of welding processes
Develop and implement documents and procedures for validation of welding equipment and processes to meet or exceed customer specifications
Supervise and manage the setup and programming of robots for welding
Promote continual improvement in weld quality and weld processes
Maintain weld drawings
Achieve department objectives in support of company production, quality, and safety goals
Work effectively with Q.A., Engineering and Production departments' associates for continual improvement of department methods, procedures, and policies; assist in the implementation of
Communicate effectively with company personnel, customers, and vendors
Attend and participate in department meetings, plant meetings, and training; participate in customer visitations as designated by the department manager
Support new program launches and customer expectations
Provide reports as required by the Engineering Manager or other departments
Participate in Continual Improvement activities
Adhere to customer requirements, Business Operating System, and company policies
Perform other duties as assigned

The work environment is a combination of office and manufacturing plant, with an emphasis on manufacturing plant. The individual must be able to perform all essential functions as appropriate on the plant floor, in meetings, and with employees, management, customers and suppliers.

4 Year Weld Engineering Degree or equivalent
Minimum 3 - 5 years' experience in an automotive welding engineering, design, and program development environment
Resistance Welding Experience

Proficiency with Advanced Product Quality Planning methods
Strong Computer Skills
Able to travel

Recommend design changes to improve quality, reliability, and productivity of welding processes

Supervise and manage the setup and programming of robots for welding

Maintain weld drawings
Achieve department objectives in support of company production, quality, and safety goals

The work environment is a combination of office and manufacturing plant, with an emphasis on manufacturing plant. The individual must be able to perform all essential functions as appropriate on the plant floor, in meetings, and with employees, management, customers and suppliers. Some of the equipment and tools used are computer, telephone, fax machine, copier/printer, and a projector.
